Sam (People Ops): FYI: All-hands Friday 11:15am PT. Two asks: drop 1-2 line agenda bullets here, and add any questions by Thu EOD. We'll record + post notes.

Elliot (CEO): I'll open with a short exec update and one org-level ask about focus areas this quarter.

Rosa (Product): I'll do a 7-min walk-through of the Dedicated autopilot canary and a quick plug for the pilot customers.

Ben (Eng): I'll cover a brief incident postmortem highlight (what we learned, action owners) and the new debug-log retention policy change that affects Dedicated customers.

Asha (Platform): I'll share an ops slide: p95 latency delta after KV cache + early quantization notes.

Lin (Support): I'll summarize CS feedback from the pilot (one blocker, one win) and the support path for retention exceptions.

Sam (People Ops): Draft agenda: 11:15 start (Elliot), 11:20 Product demo (Rosa), 11:28 Incident recap + policy note (Ben), 11:36 Platform metrics (Asha), 11:42 CS highlight (Lin), 11:45 Q&A, 12:00 Close + Next Steps. Keep bullets short please.

Rosa (Product): Can we ask infra to be on standby for rollout questions? @Ben @Asha

Ben (Eng): available. quick paste-able troubleshooting snippet for Q&A:
```
redwoodctl diagnose inference --tail=100
redwoodctl config get batching
```

Ben (Eng): Incident summary (short): transient leader-election flapping caused 5m elevated latencies; mitigated by increasing leader backoff and rolling restart. Action owners: Ben (fix), Asha (monitoring alert tweak).

Asha (Platform): I'll add the alert adjustments and the p95 chart to the slides. Expect p95 ~17% better post-cache.

Sam (People Ops): Policy note for slides: default debug-log retention shortened to 30 days; Dedicated customers can request extended retention via support with documented requirements.

Lin (Support): I'll drop the KB link in the slides and a one-line support flow.

Elliot (CEO): TL;DR for folks who miss it: 1) Autopilot canary + pilot updates, 2) incident recap + monitoring changes, 3) retention policy: 30-day default, Dedicated exceptions via support, 4) p95 perf gains. Recording + slides after.

bot-reminder: Calendar invite posted -> https://calendar.example.com/event/4234567890. Reminder scheduled.

(After meeting) bot-reminder: Recording + slides -> https://videos.example.com/recordings/4234567890 and https://drive.example.com/4234567890-slides.pdf

Sam (People Ops): Post-meeting TL;DR: canary next week (owners in follow-up doc), incident actions opened (Ben/Asha), retention default = 30 days (Support KB linked), p95 down ~17%. Follow-up doc: https://docs.redwood.example.org/allhands/4234567890-followup

Rosa (Product): I'll create the rollout checklist and sync owners.

Ben (Eng): RFC for retention/migration linked: https://docs.redwood.example.org/rfcs/retention-2026

Lin (Support): If you asked a question that wasn't answered live, reply here and I'll route it. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
